text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru, we're in the same race today.
Um... let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—is how scared I would've been up until last year.
Now it's easy-peasy, lemon squeezy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I am fortune's favorite, after all.
I even proved what I'm capable of at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, were you able to see
what lies beyond speed? Hehehe, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I can see above the clouds!
I'm so lucky, it's like I can see God Himself in plain view.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today is a head-on clash between the celestial being and the speedster.
However...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm not getting worked up.
If you just leave it to heaven, it's an easy-peasy win~
Silence Suzuka glances over at me from the corner of her eye.

...It's not really okay. Ever since the Kikuka Sho,
there's been a tendency to rely too much on luck, but...

The look in her eyes is particularly dangerous today.
I've got a bad feeling about this.
